## Summary

Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience designing, delivering
and operating high-quality software solutions across Europe and Asia. Strong
technical craftsmanship combined with product-minded thinking and a track
record of shipping reliable systems for enterprise customers. Career began at
Pyxisnet Limited (Bangladesh–Denmark JV), progressed through platform and CMS
engineering at Stibo DX (formerly Escenic AS), included a Fredskorpset
exchange in Oslo, and a role as Chartered Engineer for Big Data & DWH at
Banglalink Digital Communication. Currently a Senior Software Engineer at
IKEA, designing scalable, easy-to-operate systems.
